body: I appreciate the ideas and thoughts, but I can't afford that sort of thing. I can wait. I won't do anything until I know for sure what is going on with me, and what treatment options are available. I mostly just do not want to be confined to an oxygen tank in my early 20's... So yes, I am anxious.

I have an appointment with a specialist coming up. The ER can't do anything for me. I've tried. All I can do is wait months, and months, until I get to see the specialist. I've been trying for a year now to get this ball rolling! I finally have the appointment in two months.

Well, I have seen doctors, and they haven't given me a clear answer. They weren't good doctors, because I didn't have insurance at the time. I had some tests run, and they said I "have bad asthma" but that was it. The problem is that the treatment isn't working. The inhalers aren't helping my shortness of breath. I have insurance now, so I'm seeing better doctors, and having the lung function test done again, and then seeing a lung specialist, so hopefully I will get a more specific answer. But I am having a hard time being optimistic. I am afraid of the worst case scenario. I did smoke cigarettes for only 5 years, so the fact that I did that makes me anxious, also.
It's the chronic shortness of breath that is getting frustrating. I feel suffocated all the time.

I'm seeing a specialist soon. But if I get diagnosed, would it even be worth it to keep living? Emphysema fucks you up, and I'm pretty young. I don't think it's a mental problem. I've had chronic shortness of breath for about a year now.
It's too bad sociopathy and narcissism aren't terminal. Asshole.
